# Gødstrup Hospital

Gødstrup Hospital's medical department participates in the DANIBD registry with 78% compliance in F-calpro monitoring.

- Page 9: "Gødstrup Medicinsk Afdeling" [^src1]

## Relationships

- [[danibd|DANIBD]] — participates-in [^src2]. Evidence: "Gødstrup Medicinsk Afdeling 78 / 120 65 (56-73)" (Page 10)
- [[koloskopi]] — has-low-compliance-with [^src3]. Evidence: "Gødstrup er en af fire afdelinger, hvor under 70 % af de nydiagnosticerede voksne er udredt med koloskopi" (Page 11)
- [[danibd|DANIBD]] — conducted-audit-for [^src9]. Evidence: "Regionshospitalet Gødstrup har lavet journalaudit på indikator 6, Re-operation." (Page 46)

## Claims

- Gødstrup Medicinsk Afdeling: 336 / 430 patienter (78%) får målt F-calpro mindst én gang årligt ([[goedstrup-hospital|Gødstrup Hospital]])
- Gødstrup Medicinsk Afdeling opnåede 65 % (56-73) for Indikator 1a ([[goedstrup-hospital|Gødstrup Hospital]])
- Fire afdelinger (Hvidovre, OUH Svendborg, Aarhus og Gødstrup) har under 70 % af nydiagnosticerede voksne udredt med koloskopi ([[hvidovre|Hvidovre]], [[ouh-svendborg|OUH Svendborg]], [[aarhus-university-hospital|Aarhus University Hospital]], [[goedstrup-hospital|Gødstrup Hospital]], [[koloskopi]])
- Regionshospitalet Gødstrup reviewed 7 cases of re-operation, finding surgical complications in 3 cases and no signs of surgical complications in 4 cases ([[goedstrup-hospital|Gødstrup Hospital]])
- Regionshospitalet Gødstrup considers re-operation rate a poor quality measure, arguing that anastomotic leak is a better indicator as used in cancer surgery ([[goedstrup-hospital|Gødstrup Hospital]])
